def factor_volume_weighted_upper_shadow(df):
    """
    Volume‑weighted upper shadow: (high - max(open, close)) * volume / median volume.
    Captures selling pressure with conviction. Smoothed with 5‑day EMA.
    """
    df_copy = df.copy()
    high = df_copy["high"]
    open_ = df_copy["open"]
    close = df_copy["close"]
    vol = df_copy["volume"]
    # Upper shadow length
    upper_shadow = high - np.maximum(open_, close)
    # Volume normalized by 20‑day rolling median
    vol_med = vol.rolling(20, min_periods=1).median().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    vol_norm = vol / vol_med
    # Combine; fill NaNs with 0 (range zero or missing volume implies zero signal)
    raw = upper_shadow * vol_norm
    raw_filled = raw.fillna(0.0)
    smoothed = raw_filled.ewm(span=5, adjust=False).mean()
    df_copy["factor_volume_weighted_upper_shadow"] = smoothed
    return df_copy["factor_volume_weighted_upper_shadow"]
description: Upper shadows represent intraday selling pressure that pushed price below the high. Weighting by volume captures conviction: heavy volume alongside a long upper shadow suggests distribution rather than noise. Cross‑sectional ranking identifies stocks with strongest bearish pressure. EMA smoothing ensures the signal persists.
